verdict.rationale: Docs mention deploying the agent only 'on the topics the agent is trained for' and having a human step in when the AI can't resolve a conversation, plus escalation paths for 'sensitive situations' in outbound — suggestive of topic-scoped deployment and handoff, but there is no explicit feature for an ops lead to designate specific topics (legal threats, cancellations, security) as strictly human-only with guaranteed non-engagement by the agent. missing for 10: explicit topic-exclusion/human-only tagging mechanism, enforcement guarantees against agent freelancing, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this control.
